            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in 'customerCode',

              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Assigned when an owner is

                email (empty when absent) and the household ID (empty when absent). Creating an owner

              minimum: 0

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri

          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.

    Specialty:
      title: Specialty

      type: object

          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1

          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.

          minLength: 1
          example: radiology

        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner, stored and returned in E.164 form. Spaces,
            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers
            with country code '+61' must have exactly 9 national digits and numbers with country
            code '+1' exactly 10.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a syntactically
            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for the
            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner registered with the clinic. On create, when omitted it defaults to
            the server's current date. A Saturday or Sunday (supplied or defaulted) is rolled
            forward to the following Monday.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Set to true on create to join the household of existing owners with the same last name
            and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). When such owners
            exist, the new owner joins their household and all of them share the same 'householdId'.
            Not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters
                of the city, a dash, the upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a dash, and
                a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of owners
                already in that city (compared case-insensitively) at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'MAD-FRA-0002'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in 'customerCode',
                ignoring all non-digit characters. Absent when the owner has no customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true at the address of an existing owner with the
                same last name; the existing household's ID is reused, or a new one is generated and
                also given to the existing owners. Absent for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: '3f2b8c1e-7a4d-4e8b-9c1a-2d5e6f7a8b9c'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived identity used for duplicate detection, formatted as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the normalized telephone, the lower-cased
                email (empty when absent) and the household ID (empty when absent). Creating an owner
                whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409 Conflict;
                owners differing in any part, e.g. household members with different telephones, are
                allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: the number of owners that already existed before this owner was
                created with the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                registration date's year, e.g. 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'. Absent when the owner has no
                customer code or registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'MAD-FRA-0002-M20'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when
                'namesakeCount' is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the city using the fixed table Sydney -> 'NSW',
                Melbourne -> 'VIC', Brisbane -> 'QLD'; 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for the
                same (business-day adjusted) registration date before this owner, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner, stored and returned in E.164 form. Spaces,
            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers
            with country code '+61' must have exactly 9 national digits and numbers with country
            code '+1' exactly 10.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a syntactically
            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for the
            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner registered with the clinic. On create, when omitted it defaults to
            the server's current date. A Saturday or Sunday (supplied or defaulted) is rolled
            forward to the following Monday.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Set to true on create to join the household of existing owners with the same last name
            and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). When such owners
            exist, the new owner joins their household and all of them share the same 'householdId'.
            Not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region whose postcode range contains
                the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; when the postcode is absent
                or in no range, the region of the city as for 'locality', otherwise 'UNKNOWN'), a dash,
                and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the
                normalized telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in 'customerCode',
                ignoring all non-digit characters. Absent when the owner has no customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true at the address of an existing owner with the
                same last name; the existing household's ID is reused, or a new one is generated and
                also given to the existing owners. Absent for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: '3f2b8c1e-7a4d-4e8b-9c1a-2d5e6f7a8b9c'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived identity used for duplicate detection, formatted as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the normalized telephone, the lower-cased
                email (empty when absent) and the household ID (empty when absent). Creating an owner
                whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409 Conflict;
                owners differing in any part, e.g. household members with different telephones, are
                allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: the number of owners that already existed before this owner was
                created with the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                registration date's year, e.g. 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'. Absent when the owner has no
                customer code or registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'MAD-FRA-0002-M20'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when
                'namesakeCount' is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the city using the fixed table Sydney -> 'NSW',
                Melbourne -> 'VIC', Brisbane -> 'QLD'; 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for the
                same (business-day adjusted) registration date before this owner, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        lastName:
          title: Last name

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

          title: Address

        city:
          title: City

            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers

            code '+1' exactly 10.

          maxLength: 20

            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.

            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.

            exist, the new owner joins their household and all of them share the same 'householdId'.

                or in no range, the region of the city as for 'locality', otherwise 'UNKNOWN'), a dash,
